result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-leg intersection that lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The roadway surface is in poor condition with faded lane markings, and the large, open geometry suggests high exposure for pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this wide intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground across the intersection

hazards.name: Faded lane markings
hazards.description: Roadway markings are significantly worn, which can lead to driver confusion and unpredictable vehicle positioning.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The expansive width of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

result.summary: The residential environment lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps at the intersection. Significant visual obstructions from overgrown vegetation and poor pavement conditions further compromise pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trees and dense bushes at the corner block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or curb ramps are provided for pedestrians wishing to cross the street.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt surface creates potential tripping hazards.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and ADA-compliant curb ramps to define pedestrian space and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim trees and bushes near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway to eliminate tripping hazards and improve the walking surface.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide residential intersection with significant pavement degradation and a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings. While sidewalks are present on at least one side, the environment is dominated by expansive asphalt, increasing exposure risk for pedestrians.

hazards.description: Significant cracking and degradation of the asphalt surface can cause tripping hazards for pedestrians and instability for vehicles.

hazards.name: Wide Intersection Geometry
hazards.description: The large expanse of asphalt increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic while crossing the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and traffic control devices. The roadway surface is in poor condition with significant cracking and potholes, which presents hazards for both pedestrians and vehicles.
